pr.title: Retry transient remote index store failures
pr.body:
Retry transient remote index snapshot store failures

This adds a small backend-agnostic retry helper for remote index snapshot store operations. It uses dskit backoff with fixed internal defaults and retries only likely-transient failures before callers fall back to rebuilds, redundant uploads, or skipped cleanup work.

Retries are applied at safe helper boundaries so streaming operations can recreate their readers/writers between attempts. Retryable failures are logged with operation name and attempt number.

Fixes grafana/search-and-storage-team#789
